{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f'Number of customer_age == -1: {len(sales[sales["customer_age"] == -1])}')

# Check the age distribution for loyal customers
loyal_customers = sales[sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f'Age distribution for loyal customers (with -1):')
print(loyal_customers['customer_age'].describe())

# Check whether -1 is common in loyal customers
loyal_with_age_missing = loyal_customers[loyal_customers['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f'Number of loyal customers with age = -1: {len(loyal_with_age_missing)}')"}
